latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release — compress iOS videos to MP4 quickly and easily.

- Upload MOV, MP4, M4V, or AVI (up to 500MB) for fast AI compression and 1080p MP4 export.
- No manual sliders; control via simple chat prompts like “compress this to under 50MB.”
- Automatic session and token management for hassle-free cloud-based processing.
- Real-time job updates and error handling, with simple status messages.
- Supports batch uploads, stateful editing, and direct download of compressed videos.
